subject: Agriculture
title: Agrivoltaics
description: A quick, practical guide to Agrivoltaics.

hook.text: Solar panels above, crops below—agrivoltaics grows food and generates electricity on the same land.

buildup.text: Traditional solar farms compete with agriculture for land. Agrivoltaics eliminates the conflict entirely.

discovery.text: Crops under solar panels receive partial shade that reduces water needs by 15–30% in hot climates.

twist.text: Some crops—lettuce, peppers, tomatoes—actually yield more under solar panels because excess heat harms them.

climax.text: Japan leads agrivoltaics with over 2,000 installations. Farmers earn dual income—from crops and electricity.

punchline.text: Same land, two harvests—food and energy. The sun gives enough for both.

quiz.question: Why do some crops yield more under solar panels?
options: Partial shade reduces heat stress and water loss in hot climates
